title: 基于约束流形的安全且可泛化的分层多智能体强化学习
summary: 提出一种分层多智能体强化学习框架，通过低层约束流形强制执行硬安全约束，同时通过高层策略学习实现有效协调。该方法在提供理论安全保证的同时，实现了近乎完美的安全率和良好的泛化能力。
summary_en: A hierarchical multi-agent RL framework that enforces hard safety constraints via a constraint manifold at the low level while enabling effective coordination through high-level policy learning, achieving theoretical safety guarantees, near-perfect safety rates, and good generalization.
